AboutHighlights.title: Diving into the Details
AboutHighlights.subtitle: Discover what motivates me and what makes me stand out as a developer.

learning.title: Always one step ahead
learning.description:
My routine is driven by curiosity. Beyond my college studies at FACENS, I spend much of my free time exploring platforms like OneBitCode and Alura, diving deep into new stacks that can optimize my workflow. 

I believe the tech sector doesn't allow for stagnation. That's why I don't just study for the sake of it; I apply every new concept to real projects, turning theory into practical solutions.

To me, learning is a continuous and endless process.

teamwork.title: Building together is better
teamwork.description:
I believe software is a collective effort. In my day-to-day life, I value honest idea exchanges, constructive code reviews, and direct collaboration with designers and other devs to ensure we're all on the same page. I enjoy being the link that facilitates technical communication, ensuring the final delivery exceeds the initial expectation.

A strong team is the one that grows together.

resilience.title: Total focus on the solution
resilience.description:
My path has taught me that resilience is the key. I face bizarre bugs and tight deadlines as puzzles that just need patience and the right strategy to be solved.

Staying calm under pressure is one of my greatest strengths. Whether it's adjusting a complex layout in Nuvemshop or debugging backend logic, I don't give up until the solution is running perfectly and the user is satisfied. Challenges are just stepping stones to success.

tech.title: Technology with purpose
tech.description: I am fascinated by the power that a few lines of code have to transform businesses. My focus is on mastering the tools that make a difference, like React and Tailwind CSS, always keeping an eye on the latest trends in the web ecosystem. I don't limit myself to just 'making it work.' I seek to understand the 'why' behind each technology, ensuring that the technical choices I make today create a solid foundation for the project's growth tomorrow.

versatility.title: My real 360° vision
versatility.description:
My background goes beyond the screens.

Before diving fully into technology, I worked in areas like logistics and sales. This experience gave me a very clear view of how businesses operate in the 'real world,' which helps me translate real market needs into functional code. I understand the customer side, the urgency of the transport sector, and the precision of customer service.

I'm a dev who understands people as much as I understand syntax.

mentoring.title: Multiply to grow
mentoring.description:
Having served as an academic mentor at FACENS was one of the most significant experiences of my career. Teaching algorithms to beginners forced me to master the fundamentals and practice teaching on a regular basis.

Even today, I see leadership and knowledge sharing as fundamental pillars. Sharing what I know with my colleagues and friends not only helps them overcome obstacles but also solidifies my own learning and creates a much stronger environment for everyone.

clean_code.title: Code made for humans
clean_code.description:
Writing code is, above all, an act of communication. My priority is to deliver solutions that not only solve the technical problem but are also readable and easy to maintain by any developer who arrives after me. 'Dirty' code is a debt no one wants to pay.

I follow Clean Code principles for efficiency, not just theory. Well-structured code today means fewer headaches tomorrow and much faster evolution for the product.

ux_vision.title: The user at the center
ux_vision.description:
Software without good UX is incomplete software.

I seek to deeply understand the journey of whoever will use what I'm building. I work closely to turn prototypes into living, fluid interfaces, ensuring technology is invisible and ease of use is the highlight. My final goal is always to delight the user with a flawless experience.
